lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\EmlViewer\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
vendor/ ships 3 packages that the server ships itself in a major of Nextcloud 33. Both copies define the same classes, and the autoloader that is asked first decides which version runs.
pimple/pimple v3.6.2, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 33
psr/container 2.0.2, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 33
psr/http-message 2.0, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 33
